[[File:Challenges.png|center|thumb|670px|<font size="4">'''Challenges''' are default Story Act with added difficulty, but also extra rewards. You must have the Story Act complete for the world to enter the '''Challenge'''.</font>]]

Challenges change every 30 minutes
==Information==

===These are the available Challenges===

* <big>'''Tank Enemies'''</big> - Enemies have more Health and Armor
* <big>'''High Cost'''</big> - Units cost 1.5x higher to upgrade and place
* <big>'''Shield Enemies'''</big> - Enemies have 1 additional instance of shields.
* <big>'''Regen Enemies'''</big> - Enemies Regenerate health over time (except Flying enemies)
* <big>'''Short Range'''</big> - All Units have a 2/3 shorter range
* <big>'''Fast Enemies'''</big> - Enemies move faster

===These are the Challenges that are only available at Demon Academy Portal===
* <big>'''Hyper-Regen Enemies'''</big> - Enemies Regenerate even more health over time (except Flying enemies)
* <big>'''Flying Enemies'''</big> - All enemies are Flying (enemies that can regen still can regen)
* <big>'''Steel-Plated Enemies'''</big> - Enemies have thrice the health, and have 20 additional instances of shields.
* <big>'''Godspeed Enemies'''</big> - Enemies move even faster.
* <big>'''Mini Range'''</big> - All Units have a 1/4 shorter range. Note that units' AoE aren't affected, making the likes of [[Hybrid Units]] or any unit with extreme AoE viable.
* <big>'''Triple Cost'''</big> - Units cost 3x higher to upgrade and place.
